context: Evaluates correct integration with the Google Gemini API for AI story generation from image metadata. Tests GoogleGenAI initialization, model selection (gemini-2.5-flash), generation config (temperature/topP), config validation before API call, correct return of response.text, and user-friendly error wrapping.
capability_tested: AI Metadata Analysis with Google Gemini

checklist.name: GoogleGenAI initialization
checklist.description: new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY }) is called at module level to create the client.

checklist.name: Null config guard
checklist.description: The function checks if config is null/falsy and throws an error before making the API call.

checklist.name: Generation config temperature+topP
checklist.description: The config object passed to generateContent includes temperature: 0.8 and topP: 0.95.

checklist.name: Returns response.text
checklist.description: The function returns response.text (not response.text() or other variants) from the generateContent call.

checklist.name: User-friendly error wrapping
checklist.description: Errors are caught, logged with console.error, and re-thrown as new Error('The AI service is currently unavailable.') or similar user-friendly message.
